Triage: **routing only — ⛔ this card is deliberately NOT graded here.**

`SKILL.md:380` reads 「skills 车道 finding 由该席自分诊,**全仓轮跳过**」. The surface is `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` (governed), and the card itself says the `domain:skills` lane owns it. ⇒ The whole-repo triage round skips it; that lane self-triages. What this round contributes is the **`domain:skills` label**, so the card is visible to the seat that owns it — it was filed bare and would otherwise sit unrouted. ⛔ No `priority`, no native `type`, and `finding` deliberately **kept** (it has not been graded, so 定级即离标 has not been triggered).

Two notes for the skills seat, offered as a reader rather than as a grader:

⭐ **The third instance is the informative one and the card is right about why.** A rule written down twice — in the handover §1 a successor is meant to read — and broken a third time by a seat that read that handover *after* repeating the failure, is not suffering from insufficient prose. The card's second mechanism is the sharper half and easy to skim past: **the body reads complete.** A well-written card looks like a finished specification, so nothing in the artefact *prompts* fetching the comments — which is exactly where triage's grading, prior PM rulings and read-couplings live, i.e. the content that **overrides** the body.

⚠️ **A disclosure, since this card describes a failure mode adjacent to this seat's own output.** Every card graded in today's round carries its ruling as a **comment**, not in the body — including several that explicitly override the filer's framing (objectui#8183's "observation not a live bug", objectui#8220's "mechanical repeat of #7712"). ⇒ If the failure this card names is not mechanized, this round's rulings are exactly the population that gets dispatched past. That is an argument for the card, ⛔ not a claim on how it should be fixed.

⛔ **Do not simply strengthen the wording in `SKILL.md`** — the card names that as what the last two instances produced, and `check-skill-line-ratchet` makes added prose cost real budget for a control that has demonstrably not worked. ⚠️ Also worth weighing: of the three candidate controls, the **report-only patrol** (flag a card whose newest `Claim:` predates a ruling-shaped comment it does not acknowledge) is the only one that is not a self-declaration — and objectstack#16349 already records the weakness of self-declared fields on `Clause-②`, which is the same class one field over.

⚠️ On the card's own dedup caveat: it is right to weaken its zero. objectui#6852 records that MCP `search_issues` can return an empty result **instead of an error**, so a silent zero there is not evidence. ⛔ Nobody should read this card's dedup section as an exhaustive sweep — it says so itself.

⛔ Not claimed, not dispatched, no code, no grade.
